text_version.source: Cyberspace Administration of China, cac.gov.cn (source line: 中国网信网)
text_version.version: original as promulgated by Order No. 15 of seven departments (dated 2023-07-10; posted on cac.gov.cn 2023-07-13)
text_version.note: Promulgation order (令第15号) with signatories plus all 24 articles. Website navigation and footer removed. Provision IDs: 'Art. N para. P' for paragraphs (款) and 'item (k)' for listed items (项).

summary.short: Departmental rules of the CAC and six other ministries, in force 15 August 2023, governing generative AI services offered to the public in mainland China: content, training-data, data-labelling, personal-information, content-labelling and complaint duties for providers, plus security assessment and algorithm filing for services with public-opinion attributes.
summary.long: The Interim Measures apply to services that use generative AI to provide text, images, audio, video and other content to the public within the PRC. They do not apply to organisations that develop or use the technology without offering it to the domestic public, and sector-specific rules on news publishing, film and television, and literary and artistic creation take precedence. Providers and users must observe content rules (core socialist values, no prohibited content), take measures against discrimination, respect intellectual property, competition rules and personal rights, and improve transparency, accuracy and reliability. Providers must use lawful data and foundation models for training, obtain consent for personal information, improve training-data quality, set rules for data labelling, sign service agreements with users, disclose intended users and uses, guard minors against over-reliance, protect user inputs, label generated content under the deep synthesis provisions, act on illegal content and users, and run complaint channels. Services with public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity need a security assessment and an algorithm filing. Breaches are punished under the Cybersecurity, Data Security, Personal Information Protection and Science and Technology Progress laws. Where those laws are silent, authorities issue warnings, public criticism and rectification orders, and can suspend the service. The CAC can have non-compliant services from outside the PRC dealt with by technical measures.

territorial_scope.description: Generative AI services offered to the public within the PRC, including services provided from outside the PRC (Art. 20).

evidence.quote: 利用生成式人工智能技术向中华人民共和国境内公众提供生成文本、图片、音频、视频等内容的服务 [services providing generated text, images, audio, video etc. to the public within the PRC] ... 对来源于中华人民共和国境外向境内提供生成式人工智能服务不符合法律、行政法规和本办法规定的 [non-compliant generative AI services provided into the PRC from abroad]

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

events.date_text: 2023年5月23日国家互联网信息办公室2023年第12次室务会会议审议通过
events.applies_to: Adopted at the 12th 2023 office meeting of the CAC (the six co-issuing departments' concurrence is undated)

evidence.quote: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》已经2023年5月23日国家互联网信息办公室2023年第12次室务会会议审议通过 [adopted at the CAC office meeting of 23 May 2023]

events.applies_to: Order No. 15 promulgating the Measures, signed by the heads of the seven departments

evidence.quote: 国家广播电视总局局长 曹淑敏 2023年7月10日 [Director of NRTA Cao Shumin, 10 July 2023]

events.applies_to: Posting date on cac.gov.cn (website header, not part of the order)

evidence.quote: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法 2023年07月13日 15:00
本办法自2023年8月15日起施行。 [These Measures take effect on 15 August 2023.]

obligations.summary: Uphold core socialist values and do not generate content prohibited by law (subversion, threats to national security or unity, terrorism, ethnic hatred, violence, obscenity, false and harmful information).

evidence.quote: 坚持社会主义核心价值观，不得生成煽动颠覆国家政权、推翻社会主义制度 [uphold core socialist values; do not generate content inciting subversion of state power or overthrow of the socialist system]

obligations.summary: Take effective measures in algorithm design, training-data selection, model generation and optimisation, and service provision to prevent discrimination by ethnicity, belief, country, region, sex, age, occupation, health, etc.

evidence.quote: 在算法设计、训练数据选择、模型生成和优化、提供服务等过程中，采取有效措施防止产生民族、信仰、国别、地域、性别、年龄、职业、健康等歧视 [take effective measures to prevent discrimination]

obligations.summary: Respect intellectual property and business ethics, keep trade secrets, and do not use algorithm, data or platform advantages for monopolistic or unfair competitive conduct.

evidence.quote: 尊重知识产权、商业道德，保守商业秘密，不得利用算法、数据、平台等优势，实施垄断和不正当竞争行为 [no monopolistic or unfair competitive conduct using algorithm, data or platform advantages]

obligations.summary: Respect others' lawful rights: do not endanger physical or mental health or infringe rights of portrait, reputation, honour, privacy and personal information.

evidence.quote: 尊重他人合法权益，不得危害他人身心健康，不得侵害他人肖像权、名誉权、荣誉权、隐私权和个人信息权益 [do not infringe portrait, reputation, honour, privacy or personal-information rights]

obligations.summary: According to the service type, take effective measures to increase service transparency and the accuracy and reliability of generated content.

evidence.quote: 基于服务类型特点，采取有效措施，提升生成式人工智能服务的透明度，提高生成内容的准确性和可靠性 [improve transparency and the accuracy and reliability of generated content]

obligations.summary: Users of generative AI services are also bound by the Art. 4 rules (law, social morality and the five listed requirements).

evidence.quote: 提供和使用生成式人工智能服务，应当遵守法律、行政法规，尊重社会公德和伦理道德，遵守以下规定 [providing and using generative AI services must comply with laws ... and the following rules]

obligations.summary: Carry out pre-training and fine-tuning data processing lawfully: use data and foundation models from lawful sources, do not infringe intellectual property, and follow the CSL, DSL, PIPL and regulators' requirements.

evidence.quote: 应当依法开展预训练、优化训练等训练数据处理活动 [must carry out pre-training, optimisation training and other training-data processing lawfully] ... 使用具有合法来源的数据和基础模型 [use data and foundation models with lawful sources] ... 涉及知识产权的，不得侵害他人依法享有的知识产权

obligations.summary: Where training data involve personal information, obtain the individual's consent or meet another legal ground.

evidence.quote: 涉及个人信息的，应当取得个人同意或者符合法律、行政法规规定的其他情形 [obtain individual consent or meet another legal basis]

obligations.summary: Take effective measures to improve training-data quality: truthfulness, accuracy, objectivity and diversity.

evidence.quote: 采取有效措施提高训练数据质量，增强训练数据的真实性、准确性、客观性、多样性 [improve training-data quality]

obligations.summary: When data labelling is done in development, set clear, specific and operable labelling rules, assess labelling quality by sample checks, and train and supervise labelling staff.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当制定符合本办法要求的清晰、具体、可操作的标注规则；开展数据标注质量评估，抽样核验标注内容的准确性；对标注人员进行必要培训 [set labelling rules; assess labelling quality; train labelling staff]

obligations.summary: Bear the responsibilities of a network information content producer and fulfil network information security duties; where personal information is involved, bear personal-information-processor responsibilities.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当依法承担网络信息内容生产者责任，履行网络信息安全义务。涉及个人信息的，依法承担个人信息处理者责任，履行个人信息保护义务。

obligations.summary: Sign a service agreement with users who register for the service, setting out both parties' rights and obligations.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当与注册其服务的生成式人工智能服务使用者（以下称使用者）签订服务协议，明确双方权利义务 [sign service agreements with registered users]

obligations.summary: Specify and publish the intended user groups, occasions and uses of the service, and guide users to understand and use generative AI rationally and lawfully.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当明确并公开其服务的适用人群、场合、用途，指导使用者科学理性认识和依法使用生成式人工智能技术 [specify and publish intended users, occasions and uses]

obligations.summary: Take effective measures to prevent minor users from over-relying on or becoming addicted to generative AI services.

evidence.quote: 采取有效措施防范未成年人用户过度依赖或者沉迷生成式人工智能服务 [prevent minors' over-reliance on or addiction to the service]

obligations.summary: Protect users' inputs and usage records: do not collect unnecessary personal information, unlawfully retain identifying inputs and records, or unlawfully provide them to others.

evidence.quote: 提供者对使用者的输入信息和使用记录应当依法履行保护义务，不得收集非必要个人信息，不得非法留存能够识别使用者身份的输入信息和使用记录，不得非法向他人提供使用者的输入信息和使用记录。

obligations.summary: Accept and handle in a timely manner individuals' requests to access, copy, correct, supplement or delete their personal information.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当依法及时受理和处理个人关于查阅、复制、更正、补充、删除其个人信息等的请求 [handle requests to access, copy, correct, supplement or delete personal information]

obligations.summary: Label generated images, videos and other content in accordance with the Deep Synthesis Provisions.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当按照《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》对图片、视频等生成内容进行标识。 [label generated content per the Deep Synthesis Provisions]

obligations.summary: Provide a safe, stable and continuous service that ensures normal use.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当在其服务过程中，提供安全、稳定、持续的服务，保障用户正常使用。

obligations.summary: On discovering illegal content, promptly stop generation and transmission and remove it, rectify through model optimisation training, and report to the competent authorities.

evidence.quote: 提供者发现违法内容的，应当及时采取停止生成、停止传输、消除等处置措施，采取模型优化训练等措施进行整改，并向有关主管部门报告。

obligations.summary: On discovering users using the service for illegal activities, warn, restrict functions, or suspend or terminate service, keep records, and report to the competent authorities.

evidence.quote: 提供者发现使用者利用生成式人工智能服务从事违法活动的，应当依法依约采取警示、限制功能、暂停或者终止向其提供服务等处置措施，保存有关记录，并向有关主管部门报告。

obligations.summary: Establish complaint and reporting mechanisms with convenient entry points, publish procedures and response time limits, and handle and respond to public complaints promptly.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当建立健全投诉、举报机制，设置便捷的投诉、举报入口，公布处理流程和反馈时限 [establish complaint mechanisms; publish procedures and response time limits]

obligations.summary: Providers of services with public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity must carry out a security assessment under relevant national provisions.
obligations.conditional_on: Service has public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

evidence.quote: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估 [services with public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity must undergo a security assessment]

obligations.summary: The same providers must complete algorithm filing, and filing changes and cancellations, under the Algorithmic Recommendation Provisions.
obligations.conditional_on: Service has public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

evidence.quote: 并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。 [complete algorithm filing, change and cancellation procedures]

obligations.summary: Cooperate with supervisory inspections: explain training-data sources, scale and types, labelling rules and algorithmic mechanisms, and provide necessary technical and data support.

evidence.quote: 提供者应当依法予以配合，按要求对训练数据来源、规模、类型、标注规则、算法机制机理等予以说明，并提供必要的技术、数据等支持和协助。

obligations.summary: Obtain any administrative licence that laws or administrative regulations require for providing generative AI services.
obligations.conditional_on: A law or administrative regulation requires a licence

evidence.quote: 法律、行政法规规定提供生成式人工智能服务应当取得相关行政许可的，提供者应当依法取得许可。

obligations.summary: Foreign investment in generative AI services must comply with foreign-investment laws and administrative regulations.

evidence.quote: 外商投资生成式人工智能服务，应当符合外商投资相关法律、行政法规的规定。

obligations.summary: Cyberspace, development and reform, education, science and technology, industry and IT, public security, radio and television, and press and publication departments strengthen management of generative AI services within their remits.

evidence.quote: 网信、发展改革、教育、科技、工业和信息化、公安、广播电视、新闻出版等部门，依据各自职责依法加强对生成式人工智能服务的管理。

obligations.summary: Competent national authorities must develop supervisory methods suited to generative AI and issue classification-and-grading supervision rules or guidelines for its use in particular sectors.

evidence.quote: 制定相应的分类分级监管规则或者指引。 [formulate corresponding classification-and-grading supervision rules or guidelines]

obligations.summary: Authorities carry out supervisory inspections of generative AI services within their remits.

evidence.quote: 有关主管部门依据职责对生成式人工智能服务开展监督检查 [competent authorities conduct supervisory inspections]

obligations.summary: Bodies and staff involved in security assessments and inspections must keep confidential the state secrets, trade secrets, privacy and personal information they learn.

evidence.quote: 参与生成式人工智能服务安全评估和监督检查的相关机构和人员对在履行职责中知悉的国家秘密、商业秘密、个人隐私和个人信息应当依法予以保密，不得泄露或者非法向他人提供。

enforcement.triggered_by: Provider violates the Measures, where the CSL, DSL, PIPL, Science and Technology Progress Law or other laws provide penalties
enforcement.penalty_reference: Penalty provisions of the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, Science and Technology Progress Law and other laws and administrative regulations

evidence.quote: 提供者违反本办法规定的，由有关主管部门依照《中华人民共和国网络安全法》、《中华人民共和国数据安全法》、《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》、《中华人民共和国科学技术进步法》等法律、行政法规的规定予以处罚

enforcement.authority: Competent authorities (有关主管部门), within their remits
enforcement.triggered_by: Provider violates the Measures where laws and administrative regulations provide no penalty
enforcement.max_penalty_text: 责令暂停提供相关服务 [order to suspend the relevant services]
enforcement.penalty_formula: Warning, public criticism (通报批评) and order to rectify within a time limit; suspension of the relevant services if the provider refuses to rectify or the case is serious
enforcement.cure_period: Time limit set in the rectification order (责令限期改正); not stated in the text

evidence.quote: 法律、行政法规没有规定的，由有关主管部门依据职责予以警告、通报批评，责令限期改正；拒不改正或者情节严重的，责令暂停提供相关服务。

enforcement.authority: Public security organs (not named in the text)
enforcement.triggered_by: Conduct that constitutes a violation of public security administration
enforcement.penalty_reference: Public security administration penalties (治安管理处罚); the law is not named in the text

evidence.quote: 构成违反治安管理行为的，依法给予治安管理处罚 [public security administration penalties]

enforcement.penalty_reference: Criminal liability under law; the criminal statute is not named in the text

evidence.quote: 构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。 [criminal liability is pursued according to law]

enforcement.authority: National cyberspace department (国家网信部门)
enforcement.triggered_by: Generative AI services provided into the PRC from abroad that do not comply with laws, administrative regulations or the Measures
enforcement.max_penalty_text: 采取技术措施和其他必要措施予以处置 [deal with the service by technical and other necessary measures]

evidence.quote: 国家网信部门应当通知有关机构采取技术措施和其他必要措施予以处置。 [the national cyberspace department shall notify relevant bodies to take technical and other necessary measures]

definitions.term: Generative AI service (生成式人工智能服务)

evidence.quote: 利用生成式人工智能技术向中华人民共和国境内公众提供生成文本、图片、音频、视频等内容的服务（以下称生成式人工智能服务） [services that use generative AI technology to provide generated text, images, audio, video and other content to the public within the PRC]

definitions.term: Generative AI technology (生成式人工智能技术)

evidence.quote: 生成式人工智能技术，是指具有文本、图片、音频、视频等内容生成能力的模型及相关技术。 [models and related technologies able to generate text, images, audio, video and other content]

definitions.term: Generative AI service provider (生成式人工智能服务提供者)

evidence.quote: 生成式人工智能服务提供者，是指利用生成式人工智能技术提供生成式人工智能服务（包括通过提供可编程接口等方式提供生成式人工智能服务）的组织、个人。 [organisations or individuals providing generative AI services, including via programmable interfaces (APIs)]

definitions.term: Generative AI service user (生成式人工智能服务使用者)

evidence.quote: 生成式人工智能服务使用者，是指使用生成式人工智能服务生成内容的组织、个人。 [organisations or individuals that use generative AI services to generate content]

relations.target_text: 中华人民共和国网络安全法 (Cybersecurity Law of the PRC)
relations.note: Listed as a legal basis; no registry record for the 2016 Cybersecurity Law itself (registry has its 2025 amendment, cn-csl-amendment-2025)

evidence.quote: 根据《中华人民共和国网络安全法》、《中华人民共和国数据安全法》、《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》、《中华人民共和国科学技术进步法》等法律、行政法规，制定本办法。

evidence.quote: 根据《中华人民共和国网络安全法》、《中华人民共和国数据安全法》、《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》、《中华人民共和国科学技术进步法》等法律、行政法规，制定本办法。

evidence.quote: 根据《中华人民共和国网络安全法》、《中华人民共和国数据安全法》、《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》、《中华人民共和国科学技术进步法》等法律、行政法规，制定本办法。

relations.target_text: Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law, Personal Information Protection Law, Science and Technology Progress Law (penalty provisions); CSL, DSL and PIPL also for training-data processing
relations.note: Penalties for breaches of the Measures are imposed under these laws (Art. 21). Training-data processing must follow the CSL, DSL and PIPL (Art. 7 item (5)). DSL = cn-dsl-2021, PIPL = cn-pipl-2021

evidence.quote: 《中华人民共和国网络安全法》、《中华人民共和国数据安全法》、《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》等法律、行政法规的其他有关规定和有关主管部门的相关监管要求 ... 等法律、行政法规的规定予以处罚

relations.target_text: 互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定 (Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis Internet Information Services)
relations.note: Generated images, videos and other content must be labelled under these provisions

evidence.quote: 提供者应当按照《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》对图片、视频等生成内容进行标识。

relations.target_text: 互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定 (Provisions on the Management of Algorithmic Recommendations in Internet Information Services)
relations.note: Algorithm filing, change and cancellation for services with public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity follow these provisions

evidence.quote: 并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。

relations.target_text: 国家有关规定 on security assessment (unnamed national provisions)
relations.note: Security assessment for services with public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity follows national provisions that the text does not name

evidence.quote: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估

relations.target_text: State provisions on news publishing, film and television production, literary and artistic creation (unnamed)
relations.note: Other State provisions on these uses of generative AI services prevail over the Measures

evidence.quote: 国家对利用生成式人工智能服务从事新闻出版、影视制作、文艺创作等活动另有规定的，从其规定。

relations.target_text: 外商投资相关法律、行政法规 (foreign-investment laws and administrative regulations, unnamed)
relations.note: Foreign investment in generative AI services must comply with them

evidence.quote: 外商投资生成式人工智能服务，应当符合外商投资相关法律、行政法规的规定。

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoffs. Scope and extra duties turn on qualitative tests: offering services to the public within the PRC (Art. 2) and public-opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity (Art. 17). Classification-and-grading rules are delegated to sectoral rules or guidelines (Art. 16 para. 2).

entities.note: General rules; no firms or services are named. Filed services are listed in CAC filing announcements (cn-genai-filing-announcements).

notes: Exclusion: organisations that develop or use generative AI without offering services to the domestic public are outside scope (Art. 2 para. 3). Users may complain to authorities about non-compliant services (Art. 18); this is not a private right of action. Arts. 5-6 are promotional (encouraging innovation, compute sharing, public training data, secure chips and software) and create no enforceable duties. The registry's adopted date (2023-07-10) is the date of Order No. 15; the text also states CAC adoption at its office meeting of 2023-05-23. No transition period and no amendments are stated in the text.
